{{short description|American college basketball season}} {{Use American English|date=March 2026}} {{Use mdy dates|date=August 2023}} {{Infobox NCAA team season |year=2017–18 |team=UT Arlington Mavericks |sport=Basketball |image=UT Arlington Mavericks wordmark.svg |image_size=250 |conference=Sun Belt Conference |division= |short_conf=Sun Belt |CoachRank= |APRank= |record=21–13 |conf_record=10–8 |head_coach=[[Scott Cross (basketball)|Scott Cross]] |hc_year = 12th |asst_coach1=Greg Young |asst_coach2=Zak Buncik |asst_coach3=Kenneth Mangrum |stadium=[[College Park Center]] |champion= |tourney= |tourney_result= }} {{2017–18 Sun Belt Conference men's basketball standings}} The '''2017–18 UT Arlington Mavericks men's basketball team''' represented the [[University of Texas at Arlington]] during the [[2017–18 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Mavericks, led by 12th-year head coach [[Scott Cross (basketball)|Scott Cross]], played their home games at the [[College Park Center]] as members of the [[Sun Belt Conference]]. They finished the season 21–13, 10–8 in Sun Belt play to finish in fourth place. They defeated [[2017–18 Appalachian State Mountaineers men's basketball team|Appalachian State]] and [[2017–18 Louisiana Ragin' Cajuns men's basketball team|Louisiana]] to advance to the championship game of the [[2018 Sun Belt Conference men's basketball tournament|Sun Belt tournament]] where they lost to [[2017–18 Georgia State Panthers men's basketball team|Georgia State]]. Despite having 21 wins, they did not participate in a postseason tournament. On March 26, 2018, Cross was fired after 12 seasons at UT Arlington, along with his entire staff, with UTA's Athletic Director citing a change in the program's leadership.{{cite news|url=http://www.star-telegram.com/latest-news/article206893689.html|title=UT Arlington makes sweeping changes, fires basketball coach Scott Cross, assistants|newspaper=[[Fort Worth Star-Telegram]]|first=David|last=Humphrey|date=March 26, 2018|accessdate=March 26, 2018}} On April 6, the school hired former [[Texas Tech Red Raiders basketball|Texas Tech]] assistant [[Chris Ogden]] as head coach.{{Cite news|url=https://sportsday.dallasnews.com/college-sports/collegesports/2018/04/05/ut-arlington-will-announce-texas-tech-assistant-chris-ogden-new-mens-basketball-coach-friday|title=UT-Arlington to announce Texas Tech assistant Chris Ogden as its new men's basketball coach Friday|date=2018-04-05|work=SportsDay|access-date=2018-04-06|language=en}} ==Previous season== The [[2016–17 Texas–Arlington Mavericks men's basketball team|Mavericks]] finished the [[2016–17 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2016–17 season]] 27–9, 14–4 in Sun Belt play to win the Sun Belt regular season championship.{{Cite news|url=https://sportsday.dallasnews.com/college-sports/collegesports/2017/03/05/clinching-regular-season-sun-belt-title-ut-arlington-chasing-march-madness-dream|title=After clinching regular-season Sun Belt title, UT Arlington chasing March Madness: 'It's a dream'|date=2017-03-05|work=SportsDay|access-date=2017-12-06|language=en}} In the [[2017 Sun Belt Conference men's basketball tournament|Sun Belt tournament]], they defeated [[2016–17 Coastal Carolina Chanticleers men's basketball team|Coastal Carolina]]{{Cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap?gameId=400946071|title=Coastal Carolina vs. UT Arlington -
